title: The most recent build's result
description: Written by the tool watching for saves, each time it rebuilds. The interface reads this to answer "why has the drawing not changed" (placed atomically, in the same manner as ADR-0018).

schemaVersion.description: The version of this format. How it is raised is ADR-0018 decision 5.

ok.description: Whether the build succeeded. Even when false, the version from before keeps running.

output.description: The build's output. What went wrong goes here. Warnings can appear even on success.

stamp.description: Which generation of the source this build was made from. The same value as the stamp in an observation reply.

configuration.description: Which configuration it was built with. Numbers cannot be compared without knowing which ground they came from.

launched.description: Whether the swapped-in sketch came up. If absent, the writer predates this field (read ok alone). ok true with this false means it built but is not running, which is the one shape where a frozen drawing reads as success. It is not in required because putting it there would stop older writers' records from validating (the shape ADR-0018 decision 5's revision hit with frames).

timings.description: How long it took, broken down (milliseconds). Looking only at the total means guessing at what is slow, and guessing wrong. From noticing the change to the new picture showing is detectMs + buildMs + firstFrameMs. firstFrameMs counts from the same moment as relaunchMs and so contains all of it: do not add both. The wait between saving and the watcher noticing (up to one polling interval) is in none of them.

detectMs.description: From noticing the change to starting the build, which is the wait for a build already running. It does not start at the save itself: the watcher sees only a stamp of the sources, not when they were saved. Omitted on the first build.

buildMs.description: How long the build itself took.

relaunchMs.description: Swapping it in: from winding down the old sketch to having started the new one. It stops once the new process is started, before any picture from it shows; firstFrameMs covers that. Omitted when the build failed.

firstFrameMs.description: From starting the swap to the new sketch's first frame being taken up by the tool's window. Not in the record when it is first written: the watcher adds it and rewrites the record once the window signals the change. Omitted when the watcher has no window (nothing signals it), when no picture had been shown yet (the first signal does not wait for a frame), when the previous version had not shown yet and was still running (the signal could be for either), and when a later record replaced this one first.
